summary.headline: Three Degrees of Virtue
summary.text: An astrological-theological discussion of three degrees of virtue—spiritual, psychic, and fleshly—illustrated through Paul, Jesus’ teachings, the Gospel parables of the talents and unjust steward, and the progression from sun to moon to bright star. It contrasts extreme virtue and virginity with rational cosmic philosophy, marriage, and the worldly provision associated with doctors, astrologers, Platonists, and Aristotelians.
